_comment: Polar-ready product catalog for agenticincome.ai. Source of truth for product metadata; ops/POLAR-SETUP.md is the runbook that turns these entries into live Polar products. Prices in cents. interval: null = one-time purchase.
_note: Paid payloads must move to private delivery (Polar file delivery or a private repo granted via license key) before this repo goes public. Until then, products/blueprint/*.md and products/private-intel/*.md are the paid content sitting in a private repo — do NOT open-source this repo with them in it.
_checkoutGate: `status` is the machine-readable sale gate read by lib/polar.ts. A product may be sold ONLY when its status starts with 'for sale' (case-insensitive); every other value refuses checkout, so an unrecognized or misspelled status fails closed instead of opening a sale. Setting the POLAR_* env vars alone does not open checkout — the status here must be flipped too. Activation checklist: ops/POLAR-SETUP.md.
refund_policy: 30-day no-questions refund on all paid one-time products; subscriptions cancelable anytime, first-month refund on request.
